q1: Does it merge or deploy automatically?
a1: No. Review and merge on your code hosting platform. A merged MR / PR does not mean the code is deployed.
a2: Browse, organize, and back up local records offline. Remote Git operations and MR / PR syncing require a connection.
a3: Local Git, a cloned repository, and remote access. Configure a platform token to create MRs / PRs automatically.
